title: Unify error envelope and cursors
description: 12-error-pagination. corundum:Error vs ReplyRejection; retryAfter seconds vs ISO timestamp; RESUME_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED missing; cursors: stateless keyset cannot expire, bind to collection/filter/direction, MAC so INVALID_CURSOR is detectable; state which endpoints paginate.
close_reason: One corundum:Error envelope (ReplyRejection = REPLY_REJECTED + details.reason), integer retryAfter, complete code registry, stateless MAC'd non-expiring cursors. Leftovers noted on esol.9 and esol.7.
